name: slice_insert
declaration: unsafe fn slice_insert < T > (slice : & mut [MaybeUninit < T >] , idx : usize , val : T)
documentation:
Inserts a value into a slice of initialized elements followed by one uninitialized element.

 # Safety
 The slice has more than `idx` elements.
rules: For safety, `slice.len()` must be greater than `idx`.
